pin.estimand: Independent token_delta settlement replication of the some-or-all / some-but-not-all construct against complete careful-English disclosures, using sixteen fresh pairs in monitoring, deployment, access, networking, and compliance domains.
admissibility_gates: form_coverage: exactly eight fresh pairs per form; otherwise abort
mapping_fidelity: every English side states both truth-conditional commitments of its form; otherwise abort
different_inputs: no item repeats any sentence or subject class from the original manifest; otherwise abort
pair_heterogeneity: pooled per-pair token deltas must contain at least two distinct values; otherwise abort
instrument_availability: both pinned tiktoken encodings must load and return finite results; otherwise abort

test_set.english: At least one sensor is offline, and every sensor may be offline.

test_set.english: At least one build job timed out, and every build job may have timed out.

At least one account lost access, and every account may have lost access.
At least one packet was dropped, and it may be that all packets were dropped.
At least one permit expired, and every permit may have expired.

test_set.english: At least one build job timed out and at least one build job completed.
At least one region rejected the deployment and at least one region accepted it.
At least one account lost access and at least one account retained access.
At least one packet was dropped and at least one packet was delivered.
At least one permit expired and at least one permit remains valid.
At least one module emits the warning and at least one module does not.

manifest.method: For each fresh pair and tokenizer, delta = len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) with tiktoken cl100k_base and o200k_base. Per-model value is the mean over sixteen pairs, eight per form; the reported value is the worst (least favourable) tokenizer mean; lo/hi are the minimum/maximum per-pair deltas across both tokenizers. Each English side spells both commitments: existential plus all-case left open for some-or-all, or existential satisfier plus existential non-satisfier for some-but-not-all. Domains and sentences are disjoint from the original manifest.
